name: Hemolysis Pump Benchmark
description: A standardized pump model and optimized hemolysis testing protocol to evaluate blood pump hemocompatibility under controlled conditions.
evaluation_method: numeric hemolysis measurement (e.g., normalized index of hemolysis or percent hemolysis); when used for predictive models, typical ML metrics such as RMSE or MAE are applied
general_score_metric: normalized index of hemolysis (NIH) or percent hemolysis
reputation: Recognized within biomedical engineering and hemocompatibility research as a standardized experimental protocol and benchmark, but niche and mainly used by specialized labs.
notes: Experimental and lab-based benchmark with small-sample and protocol variability; requires physical equipment and biological materials. Not an LLM benchmark; results are sensitive to test conditions (flow, anticoagulation, blood source) and may not generalize across labs.
